# celikpanel-render v2 sha256=ebd5266bb84fed0b370a385e3bebd8b8f1fac0773278ac5facb60b6164df8292

# Kendi ayarlarınız /etc/systemd/system/celikapp-4.service.d/*.conf içine; CelikPanel onlara dokunmaz. Bu dosyadaki bir değişiklik korunur.
[Unit]
Description=CelikPanel app: set13-n.test
After=network.target

[Service]
User=www-data
WorkingDirectory=/var/www/celikpanel/subscriptions/2/sites/4/public_html
Environment=PORT=3001
Environment=NODE_ENV=production
Environment=PATH=/opt/celikpanel/runtimes/node/22.20.0/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin
ExecStart=/bin/sh -c 'node -e "require('\''http'\'').createServer((q,s)=>s.end('\''set13-n1'\'')).listen(process.env.PORT)"'
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3

# set10: added by the server owner by hand
Environment=SET10_OWNER=unit

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
